question: Hangi yapı, bir ürünü PM ve PE seviyesinde kanıta dayalı analiz edip iyileştirmeyi rutin hale getirir; ve tezgah'ta ürün sorularına verilen araştırma neden zayıf kalıyor?

evaluation.metric: number of the eight fixed product prompts that arm the product rule (baseline 0), and whether the shipped skill's scorecard can be applied to a real product question
evaluation.baseline: 0 of 8 product prompts armed any rule (executed 2026-09-19, recorded in findings.md)
evaluation.metric_note: The metric is a routing and applicability proxy for this line's goal and says so: it counts how many of the eight prompts arm the rule and whether the scorecard can be applied to a real product question, and neither half reads an answer. The goal measurement - one paired run on the same prompts with and without the rule, each answer scored blind against the scorecard - is named in to_human/report.md and was NOT run (review finding F3, reframed 2026-09-22). The metric, the baseline and locked_at above are unchanged since they were locked; this note was added in the closing pass and is recorded as such in the session events and log.md.

hypotheses: H1 (CONFIRMED, the baseline): a product-shaped prompt arms no rule, so no evidence discipline reaches the model on a product question. Measured 2026-09-19: all eight product prompts armed nothing (C1).

H2 (CONFIRMED): a dedicated conditional rule plus a skill that names its standards and evidence classes fixes the routing gap without new machinery (the research workspace is reused). Measured: the rule is the documented route (C8), the workspace's claim checks are reused unchanged (C3), and no new component was added.

H3 (CONFIRMED): the fix is observable: the eight prompts change from 'none' to 'product', and the skill ships on every host. Measured: the eight product prompts arm product and the two controls arm nothing, on the real injection path and with session_start carrying nothing (C9), and the skill is in SKILLS with a readable SKILL.md on every host (AC4, tests/test_skills.py).

events.what: the user states the problem: product analysis at PM and PE level keeps coming out weak, and asks for research plus a structure.
the user asks for current internet research, and asks whether GitHub packages with skills exist.
read the CHI 2010 HEART paper, the DORA 2025 report and companion insight, the MSR/OpenAlex SPACE record, the arXiv hallucination survey, and the MIT pm-skills marketplace.
ran classify_prompt on eight product prompts: all eight armed nothing.
that the fix belongs in the routing layer plus one skill, and that the marketplace should be referenced rather than vendored.
consulted external models on the design before building it.
built the rule and the skill, then fixed five test failures and shifted 300+ doc citations back onto the symbols they name.
verified: 931 tests OK, ruff clean, compileall clean, citations 0 outside, and the injection path carries the paragraph for a product prompt only.
that the marketplace should stay referenced rather than vendored; the user has not confirmed it.

closing pass: re-derived the suite count by loading the tree of the landing commit 2a5a29e (932 test cases; 928 at its parent, 1333 at HEAD), which reconciles the 932 in log.md row 19 with the 931 recorded above and in the report.

read literature/02-space-2021-forsgren.md and recorded what it holds (the verbatim SPACE abstract, ACM's 403 on the full text, the five dimensions deliberately omitted), then pointed the report's named-standards row at the abstract the line actually used.

reframed review finding F3 rather than answering it: the locked metric is a routing and applicability proxy, the headline goal is unmeasured, and the paired run that would measure it is named and left unrun.

settled F6 through the CLI: C10c supersedes C10 and cites the artifact the vendoring decision produced instead of the two models' agreement; the first correction row C10b lost its apostrophes to shell quoting and is superseded by C10c.
closed the review's four findings with a reason each in to_human/review.json, dated the two findings.md bullets that disagreed about arming, and added the closing-pass rows to log.md.
